notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Welcome back fellow knights! We have a Halloween related special for you.
New spooky map, FOUR different pumpkin helmets and the last boss missing a head? Sounds like a challenge!
We would also like to announce a discount pack including both of our recwnt games for some festive marathon - Jousting VR and KAIJU MONSTER VR.

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
The new and updated demo is out now for all of you knights waiting out there!
We've changed the SDK to OpenXR so now the game works identically on all listed headsets.
